Changes by the Veyra evaluation: trim the intervals below, remove audio, resize to 640×480,
encode H264 with FFmpeg. No endorsement by the original creator is implied.
Downloaded source SHA256: `68b94c8a7c38755b0394af728ac7f83446bef607d1faa37c38047f389870ddfb`.
The full 12,552,340-byte source is not bundled; three derivatives total 361,213 bytes.

| File | Original interval | Derivative duration | Independently reviewed visible labels |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| scenery.mp4 | [0s,3s) requested | 3003ms | Grass, trees and landscape; no bicycle/person visible in reviewed frames |
| cycling.mp4 | [8s,12s) requested | 4004ms | Bicycle and helmeted person; cycling/jumping, bushes/trees |
| green-shirt.mp4 | [34s,38s) requested | 4004ms | Bicycle and person with a green shirt/blue pants; cycling, trees/path |

Durations above are actual FFprobe measurements (30000/1001 fps); trimming rounds to frames.

Labels were reviewed from 2fps contact sheets on October 26, 2026, not produced by Muse.
They are clip-level annotations; exact object entry/exit times are deliberately unannotated.
No red-jacket positive, entrance, garage, night scene, identity or demographic label is claimed.
Evaluation camera names and UTC origins describe controlled replays/imports, not the film's
original capture camera or capture clock. This small single-source set cannot establish
general surveillance accuracy or red-jacket recall. Scripted provider labels are test inputs,
not measured AI correctness. Live evaluation must record actual Muse output and predictions.
